requirements.description: The user wants the property near public transport. Expressed as proximity, so the threshold is the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93), rounded to 71.

The user requires energy class C or better, so the accepted classes are A1, A2, A3, A4, B and C. The area, capacity, location and transport requirements are not energy requirements and are excluded from this output.

User explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into a surface filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided by the RegulatoryAgent.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE surface_area >= 180 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on surface_area (>= 180 sqm), energy_class (A1 to C), and mobility (>= 71), restricted to a 3.0 km radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) using latitude/longitude. Results are ordered by distance from that point. The capacity of 14 people and the "Turin" place name were not in the extracted requirements, so no predicates were added for them.
